decisionSummary: The Aug. 19 v16 dev-publish tip is the newest valid forward CrateLink source. It moves packaging into governed candidate mode, builds before creating package bytes, and updates the shared module to the current mount-lifecycle implementation. Main is its reviewed ancestor. The divergent archive and publish refs contain superseded scaffold, historic attestation, packaging, or release evidence rather than a newer valid application source.
